parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the 'Wallpaper' package, which sits under an 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path — a canonical sample-app location. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is a sample-app file must be treated as no-action with reason_class 'sample-app-mirror'. Lifting the production 'DebugPanel' copy of 'MetricRow' into shared code to unify it with the sample-app copy would couple production semantics to demonstration code, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. No override argument applies here: there is no evidence the sample-app copy is a leftover prototype rather than a deliberate fixture.
